topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I can't believe I stumbled upon this. A bucket list, hidden away like some secret treasure map. It's full of all these wild, ambitious dreams—and not once did it cross his mind to share it with me. I've been planning our futures, thinking we were on the same page, and here he is with his own personal adventure list, not a hint of us or a future together. I knew something was off. Now I see it—every item a stark reminder of what I'm apparently not part of. Well, two can play this game. Maybe I need my own list. An eye-opening, life-changing list that doesn’t include him.
